_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — bản tiếng Anh của thanso_cap_so.json (45 cặp số). Ban biên tập viết, chờ người bản xứ duyệt. Không chấm điểm hợp / khắc.

source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. A cultural reference, not a forecast.

1-1.hoa: Both take the initiative and like getting things done — easy to fall into step when the goal is shared.
1-1.va: Both want to hold the wheel — easy to fight over who makes the call.
1-1.cung_lam: Agree clearly which areas each of you has the final say on.

1-2.hoa: One opens the way, the other keeps the peace — you complement each other easily.
1-2.va: The 1 tends to decide for both; the 2 tends to give in and then feel hurt.
1-2.cung_lam: The 1 asks first; the 2 says what they want instead of waiting to be guessed.

1-3.hoa: High energy, lots of ideas, happy starting new things together.
1-3.va: The 1 wants to move fast in one direction; the 3 tends to branch off.
1-3.cung_lam: Settle on one shared goal each quarter and both stick to it.

1-4.hoa: One starts things, the other builds the base — a pair that gets things done.
1-4.va: The 1 finds the 4 slow; the 4 finds the 1 reckless.
1-4.cung_lam: Agree on 'try small first, go big later' for every new plan.

1-5.hoa: Both love freedom and dare to try things, with few ties on each other.
1-5.va: Both find long-term commitment hard and can drift in different directions.
1-5.cung_lam: Keep a few fixed shared rituals between two free lifestyles.

1-6.hoa: The 1 brings direction, the 6 brings care — one looks after the path, the other after the people.
1-6.va: The 1 feels managed; the 6 feels unappreciated.
1-6.cung_lam: The 1 gives specific thanks; the 6 lets the 1 decide their own part.

1-7.hoa: Both are independent and respect each other's space.
1-7.va: Little sharing of feelings; easy to live side by side instead of together.
1-7.cung_lam: One evening a week to tell each other what you are really thinking.

1-8.hoa: Both ambitious and results-driven — strong when the goal is shared.
1-8.va: Two big egos, a struggle for power, quiet competition.
1-8.cung_lam: Pick a shared 'opponent' outside instead of fighting each other; keep roles clearly separate.

1-9.hoa: The 1 acts, the 9 inspires — easy to do meaningful work together.
1-9.va: The 1 finds the 9 vague; the 9 finds the 1 selfish.
1-9.cung_lam: Work together on a project with both measurable results and real meaning.

2-2.hoa: Deep understanding, gentleness, few big clashes.
2-2.va: Both avoid conflict, so small things pile up into distance.
2-2.cung_lam: Set a regular time to say one thing you are unhappy about, plainly.

2-3.hoa: The 2 listens, the 3 tells stories — a light, warm atmosphere.
2-3.va: The 3 is carefree; the 2 is easily hurt by a joke.
2-3.cung_lam: The 3 asks 'did that comment upset you?'; the 2 says so straight away.

2-4.hoa: Stable, loyal, steady — good for building something long-term together.
2-4.va: Can get dull with few surprises; the 4 can be dry about the 2's need for attention.

2-5.hoa: The 5 brings fresh air, the 2 brings warmth.
2-5.va: The 2 needs closeness, the 5 needs freedom — easily misread as love fading.
2-5.cung_lam: Put numbers on your needs for space and for connection (how many evenings a week).

2-6.hoa: Both are thoughtful and know how to look after each other — very warm.
2-6.va: Both give a lot and ask for little; resentment builds when it is not returned.
2-6.cung_lam: Each of you names one need of your own every week.

2-7.hoa: Quiet, deep, respectful of each other.
2-7.va: The 2 needs closeness, the 7 needs distance — easy to feel left out.
2-7.cung_lam: The 7 says in advance when they need time alone; the 2 has their own plans then.

2-8.hoa: The 8 handles the big picture, the 2 handles the bond — a good complement.
2-8.va: The 8 can overpower; the 2 can go quiet.
2-8.cung_lam: Big decisions always need both of you to agree.

2-9.hoa: Both are compassionate and empathise easily.
2-9.va: Both sacrifice easily and can be vague about money and responsibilities.
2-9.cung_lam: Make a clear shared financial plan.

3-3.hoa: Fun, creative, never short of things to talk about.
3-3.va: Both are scattered, with no one minding the practical side.
3-3.cung_lam: Split practical tasks on a schedule, with a shared list.

3-4.hoa: The 3 brings joy, the 4 brings certainty.
3-4.va: The 4 finds the 3 irresponsible; the 3 finds the 4 rigid.
3-4.cung_lam: The 3 keeps small promises; the 4 leaves room for spontaneity.

3-5.hoa: Lively, fun, love new experiences — rarely bored.
3-5.va: Unsettled; easy to overspend and leave things unfinished together.
3-5.cung_lam: Set a long-term shared goal and let one person keep the budget.

3-6.hoa: The 3 makes things fun, the 6 makes things warm.
3-6.va: The 6 can over-care and over-remind; the 3 feels hemmed in.
3-6.cung_lam: The 6 reminds less; the 3 takes on shared tasks without being asked.

3-7.hoa: The 3 draws the 7 out; the 7 helps the 3 go deeper.
3-7.va: The 3 finds the 7 cold; the 7 finds the 3 shallow.
3-7.cung_lam: Alternate lively activities with quiet ones.

3-8.hoa: The 3 communicates well, the 8 organises well — good for business.
3-8.va: The 8 finds the 3 not serious enough; the 3 finds the 8 too practical.
3-8.cung_lam: Split roles: the 3 handles the outside world, the 8 runs operations.

3-9.hoa: Emotionally rich; both love beauty and things that mean something.
3-9.va: Neither is very practical; easy to skip what needs doing.
3-9.cung_lam: Review practical matters (money, paperwork) together every month.

4-4.hoa: Very stable, planned and dependable with each other.
4-4.va: Rigid, slow to change, easily bored.
4-4.cung_lam: Try one new thing together every year.

4-5.hoa: The 4 gives a base, the 5 gives a breeze — you learn a lot from each other.
4-5.va: The 4 finds the 5 unsettled; the 5 finds the 4 confining.
4-5.cung_lam: Agree which parts of your shared life are 'fixed' and which are 'flexible'.

4-6.hoa: Both responsible, both caring for those around them — a solid foundation.
4-6.cung_lam: Keep some time purely for fun, with no talk of things to do.

4-7.hoa: Both serious, careful and respectful of reason.
4-7.cung_lam: Practise putting feelings into words, not only into actions.

4-8.hoa: A practical pair, good at building assets and careers.
4-8.va: Swept up in work, forgetting the relationship.
4-8.cung_lam: Keep private time separate from time spent talking money.

4-9.hoa: The 4 turns the 9's ideals into reality.
4-9.va: The 9 finds the 4 short-sighted; the 4 finds the 9 unrealistic.
4-9.cung_lam: The 9 states the purpose, the 4 makes the plan — and you sign off on it together.

5-5.hoa: Free, lively, lots of shared experiences.
5-5.va: Unsettled; commitment and routines are hard to keep.
5-5.cung_lam: Keep a few fixed commitments even while living flexibly.

5-6.hoa: The 5 brings freshness, the 6 brings a home.
5-6.va: The 6 wants to hold on, the 5 wants to go.
5-6.cung_lam: The 5 shares plans in advance; the 6 respects the space for freedom you agreed on.

5-7.hoa: Both curious and fond of exploring (the 5 outward, the 7 inward).
5-7.va: Different rhythms of life; hard to find shared time.
5-7.cung_lam: Choose experiences that are both adventurous and deep (cultural travel, learning together).

5-8.va: Both take risks and can make big mistakes by deciding fast.
5-8.cung_lam: Every big money decision waits one day and gets a third person's view.

5-9.hoa: Both expansive, fond of travel, generous.
5-9.cung_lam: Have a shared savings goal and a fixed place to come home to.

6-6.va: Both want to do the caring, so you can end up controlling each other and worn out by duty.
6-6.cung_lam: Take turns being the one who is looked after.

6-7.hoa: The 6 brings warmth, the 7 brings depth.
6-7.va: The 6 feels pushed away; the 7 feels intruded on.
6-7.cung_lam: Agree on personal space and on how to check in.

6-8.hoa: The 8 handles the material side, the 6 the emotional side — a solid household.
6-8.va: The 8 is absent; the 6 feels alone with the responsibilities.
6-8.cung_lam: The 8 shows up for important occasions as firmly as for a work commitment.

6-9.hoa: Both compassionate and fond of helping others.
6-9.va: So busy caring for others that you forget each other.
6-9.cung_lam: Make time for just the two of you before shared obligations.

7-7.hoa: You understand each other without many words and respect each other's space.
7-7.va: Too closed off; you can drift apart.
7-7.cung_lam: Share an intellectual interest so you always have something in common to talk about.

7-8.hoa: The 7 analyses, the 8 decides — good for big work.
7-8.va: The 8 finds the 7 slow; the 7 finds the 8 hasty.
7-8.cung_lam: The 7 delivers analysis by a deadline; the 8 waits until that deadline.

7-9.hoa: Both drawn to meaning, the inner life and knowledge.
7-9.va: Both are far from practical matters.
7-9.cung_lam: Make practical plans together for the things you both believe in.

8-8.hoa: Both ambitious; you can build a lot together.
8-8.va: Power struggles, competition, getting absorbed in money.
8-8.cung_lam: Keep roles clearly separate; set a shared goal that has nothing to do with money.

8-9.hoa: The 8 has resources, the 9 has ideals — you can do big, useful things.
8-9.va: The 9 finds the 8 too practical; the 8 finds the 9 wasteful.
8-9.cung_lam: Decide together on a share of income for meaningful causes and save the rest.

9-9.va: Both tend to neglect practical matters and themselves.
9-9.cung_lam: Have one person take charge of practical matters each month.
